ACCOUNT_EPM.description: The $EPMs of the node's accounts. Always pinned.

PUBLICATION.description: Dataset publications of a lane: manifests, shards, indexes, $PNM and CAR archives. FEED is "<standard>/<provider>/<source>".

SHARE.description: Records published as open shares (share links).

FLOW_ASSET.description: Files a flow or module pins through its IPFS capability, such as star catalogs, error models and ephemerides. FEED is the flow or module id.

TIP.description: Content announced to the node in pubsub tips. FEED is the topic.

PROFILE_PHOTO.description: Profile photos of the node and its accounts.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds of the last change to the policy; 0 = never changed.
